summary: Validated the new Scenario Library and Founder Note. ALLOW, VERIFY, and BLOCK stories render and replay through the shared Authority, Intent, Behavior, and Evidence model; reduced-motion mode jumps directly to the selected final state. Founder note renders on desktop and mobile. Existing Trust Receipt download and Open Console destination passed regression checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scenario Library uses local React state and existing scenario data. Open Console intentionally remains on the existing in-page destination. Receipt Image export and Gemini remain explicitly out of scope.
rca of the issue: No unresolved issue. Production build, scenario switching/replay, reduced-motion behavior, mobile overflow, founder-note rendering, receipt download, and console destination all passed.
